title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A Planeswalker and assassin, daughter of Tolvada and former leader of the Orzhov Syndicate, who fights Oba in Vitu-Ghazi and then leaves Ravnica.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The enraged third head of Trostani, who murdered Teysa and wields the Ravnican Worldsoul as a weapon until Kaya and Etrata bind her.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The three-headed dryad leader of the Selesnya Conclave, made up of Ses, Cim and Oba.

entities.name: Ses
entities.description: One of the three heads of Trostani, who weeps for her sister and accepts that Selesnya may end.

entities.name: Cim
entities.description: One of the three heads of Trostani, who says Oba is a rotten branch and that Trostani will step aside for communion with Mat'Selesnya.

entities.name: Ravnican Worldsoul
entities.description: The living soul of the plane of Ravnica, which Oba turns into a weapon and which resists Kaya's phasing until she appeals to it.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The great tree-city of the Selesnya Conclave and site of the Agency's meeting, where the fight with Oba takes place.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The Orzhov guildmaster murdered by Oba, who returns as a ghost, attends her own funeral and continues to run the Syndicate.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir assassin who plays dead after being impaled, helps Kaya bind Oba, and becomes Proft's aide.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who tends the fallen Etrata and then hires her as his assistant.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A Planeswalker and guild leader who is entangled by roots during the fight and is married to Tomik.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A guild leader who is swallowed in a cocoon of roots and later dragged off by Aurelia to be arrested.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros angel guild leader, freed from the branches and determined to see someone arrested.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: An Azorius guild leader who studies the Guildpact to find a way to arrest Oba.

entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: A guild leader who asks whether the fight is over.

entities.name: Tolsimir
entities.description: A Selesnya figure whose motionless body lies in Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Kaya's young partner at the Agency, who survives being thrown off the roof by Oba.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The head of the Agency, who told Kellan to wait outside.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: A Selesnya leader who will speak for the Conclave while Trostani is in communion.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: Ral's spouse, who made him promise not to get into reckless fights.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A Rakdos figure who has not been found since the events at the manor.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A friend of Kaya who loves the natural world and wants her help hunting a dire bear.

entities.name: Kaito
entities.description: A friend of Kaya whose lesson about moving between raindrops she recalls.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A Planeswalker Kaya recalls as a lesson in caring for the world that made you.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A Planeswalker who spoke to stones, which seemed to answer her.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Dimir guildmaster, whom Proft insists is not truly gone.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: The founder of the Azorius whose archaic financial bylaws are invoked by Teysa.

entities.name: Karlov Cathedral
entities.description: The Orzhov cathedral where Teysa's funeral is held.

entities.name: The Agency
entities.description: The investigative body that held a meeting at Vitu-Ghazi and employs Kaya, Kellan and Proft.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The guild of spies, all but gone with its guildmaster dead.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The ghost-run guild of Ravnica that Teysa leads.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The nature guild led by Trostani.

entities.name: Barrier ward
entities.description: An Agency device that seals crime scenes, deployed from two ends, used by Kaya and Etrata to bind Oba.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical contract binding Ravnica's guilds, which has no provision for Trostani's situation.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose attempts to remake worlds Kaya compares to Oba's use of the Worldsoul.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes that Kaya calls on through her spark.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Dragged through the air by a vine, Kaya reaches for her spark and calls on the Blind Eternities to help her resist the Ravnican Worldsoul.
events.quote: Kaya called the Blind Eternities, asking them not for an exit but for an escape

events.summary: Kaya slips through the vine, lands on the floor of Vitu-Ghazi and draws her daggers, while Oba howls in fury.
events.quote: Oba howled fury and disbelief as Kaya, still semi-solid, landed lightly on the floor of Vitu-Ghazi

events.summary: Kaya surveys the room: Krenko is almost absorbed into the wall and the guild leaders are entangled, including Ral, while Proft kneels by Etrata.
events.quote: The guild leaders had been entangled and subdued, even Ral

events.summary: Oba demands to know why Kaya will not die, and Kaya mocks her as she cuts down branches.
events.quote: "Why won't you die ?" Oba demanded.

events.summary: A ghostly branch of Vitu-Ghazi seizes Kaya's waist; she remembers Kaito's lesson and turns solid to escape it.
events.quote: Something wrapped around her waist, jerking her to a stop.

events.summary: Roots again hold Kaya, because the Worldsoul refuses to let her phase.
events.quote: A series of roots ripped through what was left of the floor and wrapped around her ankles.

events.summary: Kaya addresses the Worldsoul directly, arguing that a Ravnica that takes sides is no Ravnica and that Oba wants to turn it into something it is not, as the Phyrexians did.
events.quote: And I say a Ravnica that chooses one side over another is no Ravnica at all.

events.summary: Oba recoils, but Kaya remembers that this face of Trostani is responsible for Teysa's death.
events.quote: But this face of Trostani was responsible for Teysa's death

events.summary: Kaya pleads with Ravnica, the roots pass through her, and she races across the room to Oba.
events.quote: This time when she tried to phase, the roots passed right through her.

events.summary: Kaya finds an Agency barrier ward and deploys it around Oba, arguing Vitu-Ghazi is a crime scene under the Agency's authority.
events.quote: "No," she said and hit the button to deploy the barrier.

events.summary: Etrata, who had been playing dead, rises and activates the second barrier ward anchor so the two can pin Oba.
events.quote: She hit the button as she climbed to her feet, and more ribbons lashed out, twining around Oba

events.summary: Kaya seizes one of Oba's ghost branches with necromantic energy and uses it to confine her.
events.quote: She forced a jolt of necromantic energy into it and felt it bow to her command, becoming hers rather than Oba's.

events.summary: Oba is bound and the room goes still; Ses and Cim put Oba to sleep.
events.quote: Each of them pressed a hand to her temple, and she went limp.

events.summary: Kaya chooses not to kill the captive Oba, as it would be an execution.
events.quote: She couldn't do it. No matter how much she wanted to, she couldn't.

events.summary: Kaya looks at the far end of the ward and finds no one there, and Ral and Kaya laugh in relief.
events.quote: They laughed not because they were amused, but because they were alive

events.summary: Etrata reveals she was playing dead and proposes becoming Proft's assistant, as House Dimir is all but gone.
events.quote: If you take one of us home, you have to keep us.

events.summary: Kaya frees the guild leaders; Aurelia drags Krenko off to be arrested.
events.quote: all save Krenko, who found himself dragged along by a furious Aurelia determined to see someone arrested

events.summary: Cim says the Guildpact has no way to sever Oba, who remains their sister, and that a rotten branch must be removed.
events.quote: Oba remains one-third of us; we have no way to sever her.

events.summary: Cim says Trostani will go into communion with Mat'Selesnya to learn whether she wants them to remain, and Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave.
events.quote: Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave while we are in communion

events.summary: Ses promises the Guildpact will remain available to any who need it.
events.quote: Vitu-Ghazi is not fallen.

events.summary: Kaya leaves and finds Kellan unharmed outside, then cries for the first time since finding Teysa dead.
events.quote: In front of a very startled Kellan, she allowed herself to cry.

events.summary: Three days later Teysa's funeral is held at Karlov Cathedral, and her ghost sits beside Kaya.
events.quote: Three days later, Kaya sat in a pew at Karlov Cathedral

events.summary: Teysa's ghost tells Kaya she keeps leading the Syndicate in death and that it was she who helped in the fight at Vitu-Ghazi.
events.quote: Why would a little thing like death stop me from running the Syndicate?

events.summary: Teysa explains she will ruin Selesnya financially rather than use the law, and asks Kaya to leave Ravnica.
events.quote: You'll have to leave, of course.

events.summary: Kaya embraces her friend Teysa, who hugs her back.
events.quote: I thought I'd lost you,

events.summary: Kaya tells Kellan she is leaving in the morning to help Tyvar hunt a dire bear, and learns Judith is still missing and Proft has hired Etrata.
events.quote: I'm heading out in the morning,

relations.note: Oba murdered Teysa in the aftermath of the invasion.
relations.quote: Murdered by a grief-poisoned Trostani who had been unable to tell friend from foe in the aftermath of the invasion.

relations.note: Oba is one of Trostani's three heads.
Ses is one of Trostani's three heads.
relations.quote: One-third murderer or not, Trostani led Selesnya until someone said otherwise.
Trostani led Selesnya until someone said otherwise.

relations.note: Etrata and Kaya together bind Oba with the barrier wards.
relations.quote: Together, Etrata and Kaya pulled the ribbons tighter and tighter

relations.note: Kellan is Kaya's partner at the Agency.
relations.quote: hoping she wasn't going to step outside and find her partner smeared across the stones of the courtyard

relations.note: Teysa is Kaya's friend and her successor in leading the Orzhov.

relations.quote: since apparently the presence of my spouse will keep me from behaving in what he called an 'unreasonably reckless' manner.

relations.note: Proft officially hired Etrata as his aide.
relations.quote: He officially hired Etrata as his aide,

relations.note: Teysa continues to run the Syndicate as a ghost.
relations.quote: Why would a little thing like death stop me from running the Syndicate?

relations.note: Teysa plans to ruin Selesnya financially over Oba's crime.
relations.quote: the price of assassinating an Orzhov guild leader is everything you thought you owned.
